reviewedBy: Claude implementation agent for #152, 2026-10-28: automated preparation only (npm registry integrity, declared licenses, archive notices, no native code or install hooks); not independent of the audit-advisory dependency changes
scope: Complete lockfile delta from accepted baseline 84433882 to the #152 audit-advisory dependency commit: changed pins and lockfile records, including zod 4.6.7, fastify 5.12.7, fast-uri 3.1.9/4.2.3, express 5.3.0 with body-parser 2.4.0 and qs 6.17.0, undici 8.12.3, electron 44.9.3 and @cursor/sdk 1.2.0. Supersedes the 2026-10-24 refresh review. Packages shipped by the binary and web bundle (measured by a darwin-arm64 build) carry archives and notices; all others are tooling pinned by lockfile integrity. Distribution source and license review only; no legal opinion and no native relink claimed.
